blocks.content: The code of the Fibonacci series was easy to write. However, its working could be tricky to understand.
Let's calculate the number at the fifth position in the Fibonacci series, fib(4):
So, fib(4) calls fib(3) and fib(2).
Again, fib(3) requires two values: fib(2) and fib(1).
Similarly, fib(2) requires fib(1) and fib(0).
Now, fib(1) and fib(0) being the base cases, they return 1 and 0 respectively.
Once the base conditions return their values, each preceding call also starts returning values as shown in the figure below.
As you can see, the function call sequence of the Fibonacci series is not linear but forms a tree-like structure.
